scope: Complete rigid translation intervals of the settled enclosure, including all nine mounted WAGOs. The final Pisco host/cap has its own complete delta intervals; all other rigid members retain identical geometry. Cross-parent flexible spans and the pump inlet handoff stay loose until closure.

current_complete_motion_reading.method: Complete translation intervals certified from triangle-surface distances using the 1-Lipschitz translation bound. Broad-phase separation uses complete swept AABBs. Any surface contact or unresolved interval remains a witness for native follow-up. Cross-parent tubes and the loose pump inlet elbow are connected after closure through the funnel opening, per the accepted rotating-joint assembly sequence. This does not infer flexible handling or printed force.
current_complete_motion_reading.scope: Fresh complete rigid front-column, rear-base and rear-over-core translation intervals against the exact current physical quadrant STLs and current installed core, including all mounted WAGO bodies. Cross-parent flexible spans and the named pump inlet handoff remain loose until the rigid quadrants are seated. Wire handling and physical flexure force are separate.

physical_pump_upper_admission.scope: Complete interval against the exact physical lid STL. The near-seat0..0.5mm interval is certified separately using actual native gaps and the print tessellation allowance.

physical_pump_near_seat_admission.scope: Complete near-seat interval against the exact physical lid STL, starting from the separately checked native nonintersecting installed position.

current_pisco_motion_delta.scope: Only the rebuilt back-top and narrower Pisco cap repeat their complete rear-base and rear-over-core rigid intervals. Other rigid bodies retain their separately bound full translation reading. The neutral WAGO is reserved for the subsequent WAGO phase. Wires are excluded.

current_parent_binding.scope: Current added/moved stock has complete independent translation intervals. Every other current surface retains the preceding interval or is a material subtraction.

delta_reading.scope: Complete translation intervals for added or moved stock only. Retained whole-quadrant readings cover every unchanged face; all remaining changes remove stock. Wire bodies are excluded and the existing final flexible handoffs remain loose until rigid closure.

cap_removal.scope: Complete distance-certified translation intervals of released caps. Back-top is separated from the cold core and inverted on the bench; flexible tubes/leads are disconnected and dressed aside, funnel/frame/drain and the ASSE vent adapter are removed. ASSE cap is removed before the meter cap. Wing displacement is a conservative linear 3.2mm outward shear from root to catch; force, nonlinear spring shape and fatigue require physical articles.

current_parent_binding.scope: All new back-top stock is AABB-separated from every complete prior cap extraction sweep. Other back-top changes remove material. The changed aft saddle belongs to the cold core, which is absent during these bench operations.

remaining_material_findings.required_action: Move the neutral junction and its holder after publishing the settled mechanics.

assembly_prerequisites: Keep the pump suction elbow and short inlet link loose during the rear approach; complete their round joints through the uncovered funnel opening after closure.
Dress cross-parent flexible tube spans after positioning the rigid quadrants.
Separate back-top from the core before releasing the pump or rear equipment caps. Remove the ASSE cap, then the meter cap, before servicing the Pisco cap.
